feeds.title: The Thrifty Issue Blog
feeds.description: The Thrifty Issue, a beacon for Aussie mums, champions financial independence and control. Through savvy money management and resourceful tips, it empowers women to navigate life's financial terrain confidently. With a diverse team of Aussie mum writers, it offers a treasure trove of insights, experiences, recipes, and side gigs, fostering a community dedicated to making and saving more.

feeds.title: Frugal Frolicker
feeds.description: Featuring travel adventures around the world, travel photography, budget travel tips, and travel guides. Frugal Frolicker is a travel blog by Lindsay Buckley.

feeds.title: Frugal and Thriving
feeds.description: Here at Frugal and Thriving, I share what I've learned (and still learning!) on our frugal journey. I share information on how to budget your money, money saving tips, frugal recipes, simple and green living ideas.
